device_meta.description: Nespresso Essenza Mini C30: linked chain Turn machine ON -> Descaling.

components_catalog.name: Espresso button
components_catalog.description: Momentary push button. Its press (press_espresso) is offered to every machine: it turns the machine on through the LEDs machine. The button itself keeps no state.
components_catalog.location: Top surface, next to the lever (left/right order not specified in manual)

dimensions.name: contact
dimensions.description: Momentary contact: returns to released immediately after each press.

components_catalog.name: Lungo button
components_catalog.description: Momentary push button. Its press (press_lungo) is offered to every machine: it turns the machine on (LEDs) and, in descaling mode, starts each flush (Water tank).
components_catalog.location: Top surface, next to the lever (left/right order not specified in manual)

dimensions.name: contact
dimensions.description: Momentary contact: returns to released immediately after each press.

components_catalog.name: LEDs
components_catalog.description: Lights integrated in the Espresso and Lungo buttons; observable state of the machine (internal heating not modelled). Its flat volume spans both buttons and stands for pressing both buttons together for 5 s (hold_both_buttons).
components_catalog.location: Integrated in the Espresso and Lungo buttons, top surface

dimensions.name: status
dimensions.description: off; heating = lights blinking (25 s); ready = lights steady.

components_catalog.name: Lever
components_catalog.description: Opens the capsule compartment; a lift-and-close cycle ejects the capsule into the capsule container.
components_catalog.location: Top front of machine, above the coffee outlet

components_catalog.name: Drip tray
components_catalog.description: Collects drips and spills under the coffee outlet.
components_catalog.location: Front base, below the coffee outlet

components_catalog.name: Drip base
components_catalog.description: Part of the drip assembly that collects liquid; emptied before and after descaling.
components_catalog.location: Front lower part of the machine, within the drip area

dimensions.name: content
dimensions.description: contains_liquid before descaling; empty after the first emptying; empty_after_descaling after the final emptying (the liquid it collects during the flushes is not modelled).

components_catalog.name: Capsule container
components_catalog.description: Collects used capsules ejected by the lever cycle.
components_catalog.location: Inside the front of the machine, below the capsule compartment

dimensions.name: content
dimensions.description: Whether the container holds used capsules.

components_catalog.name: Water tank
components_catalog.description: Holds the water supply (0.6 L). During descaling it holds the descaling solution; each flush (Lungo button in descaling mode) drains it.

dimensions.name: content
dimensions.description: potable_water; descaling_solution (agent + water up to the 0.6 L line, or used solution poured back); drained_solution (emptied by a solution flush); empty_clean (emptied and rinsed, or emptied by a rinse flush).

components_catalog.name: Plug
components_catalog.description: Connects the appliance to a grounded power outlet.

components_catalog.name: Container
components_catalog.description: Container of at least 1 L placed under the coffee outlet to collect the descaling solution and the rinse water.
components_catalog.location: Under the coffee outlet when placed

dimensions.name: position
dimensions.description: Whether the container is under the coffee outlet.

components_catalog.name: Descaling agent
components_catalog.description: One Nespresso descaling liquid sachet poured into the water tank.
components_catalog.location: Sachet, then inside the water tank

dimensions.name: location
dimensions.description: Whether the sachet has been poured into the water tank.

scene_props.name: Coffee machine
scene_props.description: Machine body. Its internal heating and pump are not modelled; their effect is represented by the LEDs and the Water tank.

scene_props.name: Coffee outlet
scene_props.description: Spout under which the container is placed; descaling solution and rinse water flow through it.
scene_props.location: Front, under the top overhang, above the drip area

scene_props.name: Capsule compartment
scene_props.description: Cavity opened by the lever; the lever cycle of steps 1-2 ejects any capsule left in it.

scene_props.name: 0.6 L line
scene_props.description: Fill mark on the water tank used in step 7 (fill up to the 0.6 L line).

scene_props.name: Capsule
scene_props.description: Used capsule possibly left in the capsule compartment; its ejection is represented by the lever cycle (signal capsule_ejected) and the capsule container.

scene_props.name: Water
scene_props.description: Potable water and rinse water; represented through machine_water_tank.content.

procedures.name: Turn machine ON
procedures.short_description: Switches the machine on; it heats up (lights blinking, 25 s) and becomes ready (lights steady).
frequent_causes: Required before descaling, which is performed while the machine is turned on

steps.description: Press either the Espresso or the Lungo button to turn the machine ON. The lights blink while heating up (25 seconds) and stay steady when the machine is ready.
steps.simplified_description: Press one of the two coffee buttons on top. Wait until the lights stop blinking.

procedures.guard: machine_leds.status eq off and machine_plug.connection eq plugged_in

procedures.name: Descaling
procedures.short_description: Removes scale with a Nespresso descaling solution circulated twice, followed by two rinse cycles (~15 minutes)
frequent_causes: Water hardness schedule: descale after 300 (hard), 600 (medium) or 1200 (soft water) cups of 40 ml

steps.description: Lift the lever completely (manual step 1).
steps.simplified_description: Pull the lever on top all the way up.

steps.description: Close the lever to eject the capsule into the used capsule container (manual step 1).
steps.simplified_description: Push the lever down again.

steps.description: Empty the drip tray (manual step 2).
steps.simplified_description: Empty the tray at the front.

steps.description: Empty the drip base (manual step 2).
steps.simplified_description: Empty the base under the tray.

steps.description: Empty the used capsule container (manual step 2).
steps.simplified_description: Empty the box of used capsules.

steps.description: Pour 1 Nespresso descaling liquid sachet into the water tank (manual step 3).
steps.simplified_description: Pour the descaling sachet into the water tank.

steps.description: Fill the water tank up to the 0.6 L / 20.3 oz line with potable water (manual step 3).
steps.simplified_description: Add tap water to the tank up to the 0.6 L line.

steps.description: Place a container (min. 1 L / 33.8 oz) under the coffee outlet (manual step 4).
steps.simplified_description: Put the big container under the coffee spout.

steps.description: While the machine is turned on, press both the Espresso and Lungo buttons for 5 seconds to enter descaling mode; both LEDs blink (manual steps 5-6).
steps.simplified_description: Hold both coffee buttons for 5 seconds until both lights blink.

steps.description: Press the Lungo button and wait until the water tank is empty (manual step 7).
steps.simplified_description: Press the big-cup button and wait until the tank is empty.

steps.description: Take the container with the used descaling solution from under the coffee outlet (implied by manual step 8).
steps.simplified_description: Take the container out.

steps.description: Refill the water tank with the used descaling solution collected in the container (manual step 8).
steps.simplified_description: Pour the liquid from the container back into the water tank.

steps.description: Place the container under the coffee outlet again (manual step 8: repeat step 4).
steps.simplified_description: Put the container back under the coffee spout.

steps.description: Press the Lungo button and wait until the water tank is empty (manual step 8: repeat step 7).
steps.simplified_description: Press the big-cup button again and wait until the tank is empty.

steps.description: Empty and rinse the water tank (manual step 9).
steps.simplified_description: Empty the water tank and rinse it.

steps.description: Take the container away and empty it before using it again (implied by manual step 10).
steps.simplified_description: Take the container out and empty it.

steps.description: Fill the water tank with fresh potable water (manual step 9; refilled before the second rinse).
steps.simplified_description: Fill the water tank with clean tap water.

steps.description: Place the container under the coffee outlet (manual step 10: repeat step 4).
steps.simplified_description: Put the container under the coffee spout.

steps.description: Press the Lungo button and wait until the water tank is empty to rinse the machine (manual step 10: repeat step 7; done twice).
steps.simplified_description: Press the big-cup button and wait until the tank is empty.

steps.description: Press both the Espresso and Lungo buttons for 5 seconds to exit descaling mode (manual step 11).
steps.simplified_description: Hold both coffee buttons for 5 seconds until the lights stop blinking.

steps.description: Empty the drip base (manual step 12).
steps.simplified_description: Empty the base under the tray.

procedures.guard: machine_leds.status eq ready and machine_leds.mode eq normal and machine_plug.connection eq plugged_in and machine_lever.position eq closed and machine_water_tank.content eq potable_water and machine_descaling_agent.location eq sachet and machine_container.position eq absent

rules.name: Descaling solution can be harmful
rules.description: Avoid contact with eyes, skin and surfaces.

rules.name: Use only the Nespresso descaling agent
rules.description: Do not use other products such as vinegar (FR text); they leave a taste and may damage the machine.

rules.name: Descaling agent in the tank before filling
rules.description: Pour the descaling sachet into the water tank, then fill up to the 0.6 L line.

rules.name: Container under the coffee outlet before flushing
rules.description: A container of min. 1 L must be under the coffee outlet before pressing the Lungo button in descaling mode.

rules.name: Descaling mode only with the machine on
rules.description: Enter descaling mode while the machine is turned on (lights steady).

rules.name: Rinse before leaving descaling mode
rules.description: Exit descaling mode only after rinsing the machine with fresh water.

rules.name: Do not overfill the water tank
rules.description: Fill only up to the 0.6 L line.

rules.name: Fresh potable water only
rules.description: Always fill the water tank with fresh potable water.

rules.name: Never lift the lever during operation
rules.description: Risk of scalding by hot liquids.

rules.name: Do not put fingers under the coffee outlet
Descaling frequency by water hardness
rules.description: Descale after 300 (hard), 600 (medium) or 1200 (soft water) cups of 40 ml.
